catalog.title: Punch UI Component Catalog
catalog.description: Select a component below to explore its live preview, variants, props reference, and CLI installation command.

button.title: Button
button.description: Interactive button component to trigger actions or navigation with multiple variants, sizes, icons, and status states.

props.variant: Determines the button visual style: follows the active theme palette (default, secondary, outline, noShadow, ghost) or semantic status colors (success, info, warning, danger).
props.size: Controls button height and padding: sm (32px), default (40px), lg (48px), or icon (40x40px square).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow (shadow-none) and mechanical press translation on any color variant (e.g., <Button variant="danger" noShadow />).
props.isLoading: Renders a spinning Loader2 icon on the left, automatically disables the button, and sets the aria-busy attribute.
props.loadingText: Optional replacement text displayed while isLoading is true (e.g., 'Saving...').
props.disabled: Disables click interactions and mechanical press effect with 50% opacity.
props.asChild: Forwards all Button styling and props to a single child element (such as Next.js <Link />) via Radix Slot.

usageNotes: Navigation with Next.js Link: Use the asChild prop (<Button asChild><Link href="/docs">Open</Link></Button>) so the element renders as a valid semantic <a> tag.
Form Submission Handling: Pass isLoading and loadingText during async API requests to prevent duplicate form submissions.
Icon-Only Buttons: When using size="icon" without a visible text label, always provide an aria-label attribute for screen reader accessibility.
Flat Button Combinations: Combine the boolean noShadow prop with any color variant (e.g., <Button variant="danger" noShadow />) inside dense table rows or toolbars.

card.title: Card
card.description: Container for dashboard KPI cards, metric summaries, forms, and grouped data modules.

props.variant: Determines the card surface palette: theme colors (default, primary, secondary, muted) or semantic status colors (success, info, warning, danger).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow (shadow-none) for nested cards or dense grid layouts.
props.interactive: Enables pointer cursor, subtle hover lift, and mechanical press translation when clicked.
props.headerVariant: The variant prop on <CardHeader /> ('default' | 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'muted') to style the header bar as an accent color block.
props.subComponents: Composed of CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, and CardFooter for structured card anatomy.

usageNotes: Placing Actions in Header: Use <CardAction /> inside <CardHeader className="flex-row items-start justify-between"> to align badges or action buttons to the top-right corner.
Nested Cards: When placing a Card inside another Card, enable the noShadow prop on the inner card to avoid stacked double shadows.
Clickable Cards: Enable the interactive prop when the entire card acts as a selectable option (such as pricing tier cards or catalog items).

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Compact high-contrast label for theme accents, semantic status indicators, category tags, and numeric counters.

props.variant: Determines the badge palette: theme colors (default, secondary, outline, muted) or semantic status colors (success, info, warning, danger).
props.size: Controls badge font size and padding: sm (10px), default (12px), or lg (14px).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow (shadow-none) on any color variant, ideal for dense table cells or nested counters inside buttons.
props.dot: Renders a bordered circular status dot indicator on the left side of the label (ideal for Online / Offline states).
props.asChild: Forwards all Badge styling and props to a single child element (such as <Link /> or <a>) via Radix Slot.

usageNotes: Counters Inside Buttons: When embedding a Badge as a numeric counter inside a Button, combine size="sm", noShadow, and className="font-mono" to keep the button height balanced.
Clickable Filter Tags: Use the asChild prop to wrap a <Link /> or <a> element when using Badges as interactive category filters.
Live Status Indicators: Combine the dot prop with semantic variants (success, info, warning, danger) to display service or connection health in dashboard tables.

input.title: Input, Textarea & Label
input.description: Form input controls featuring crisp focus shadow shift, size variants, icon slots, addons, file upload styling, and validation states.

props.inputSize: Controls the height and font size of <Input />: sm (h-8 / 32px), default (h-10 / 40px), or lg (h-12 / 48px).
props.state: Sets validation border and focus outline color on <Input /> or <Textarea />: default, success (emerald), or error (ruby red + aria-invalid).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow both at rest and on focus, ideal when embedding Input inside a bordered prefix/suffix group or toolbar.
props.type: Supports all standard HTML input types (text, email, password, number, search, file, url, tel).
props.disabled: Disables user input interaction and reduces opacity to 50%.
props.Textarea: The <Textarea /> component accepts the same state and noShadow props as <Input /> for multi-line text fields.

usageNotes: Pairing Label & Input: Always connect the htmlFor prop on <Label /> with a matching id on <Input /> or <Textarea /> so clicking the label focuses the input field.
Positioning Icons Inside Input: Wrap <Input /> in a <div className="relative">, position the icon with absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2, and add className="pl-9" to the Input.
Building Prefix/Suffix Addons: Pass noShadow and className="border-0 rounded-none" to <Input /> when placing it inside a 2px bordered flex group.
Handling Validation Errors: Pass state="error" to automatically set aria-invalid="true" along with a high-contrast destructive border.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Profile image or initials frame supporting circle & square shapes, multiple sizes, status badges, and overlapping avatar groups.

props.size: Controls avatar dimensions: sm (32px), default (40px), lg (48px), or xl (64px).
props.shape: Sets avatar frame geometry: circle (default for user profiles) or square (follows --radius, ideal for workspace/team logos).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the avatar, recommended when stacking avatars inside <AvatarGroup />.
props.AvatarBadge: Status dot sub-component positioned at the bottom-right corner with status ('online' | 'away' | 'busy' | 'offline') and badgeSize ('sm' | 'default' | 'lg').
props.AvatarGroup: Flex container with negative spacing (-space-x-3) to stack multiple collaborator avatars cleanly.

usageNotes: Automatic Fallback: Always include an <AvatarFallback /> with 1–2 user initials inside <Avatar /> so it renders cleanly if the image fails to load.
Circle vs Square: Use shape="circle" (default) for people/user profiles, and shape="square" for team, workspace, or organization logos.
Stacking Avatars: When placing avatars inside <AvatarGroup />, add the noShadow prop to each <Avatar /> to prevent overlapping shadows.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Horizontal or vertical divider line to separate content sections, with line style, thickness, and centered label support.

props.orientation: Direction of the divider line: horizontal (default) or vertical.
props.variant: Line style of the divider: solid (default), dashed, dotted, or muted.
props.thickness: Stroke thickness of the divider: thin (1px), default (2px), or thick (4px).
props.label: Optional text or element (e.g., <Badge />) rendered in the center of a horizontal separator.
props.decorative: When true (default), treated as decorative (role="none"). Set false to expose role="separator" to screen readers.

usageNotes: Vertical Dividers in Flex Containers: When using orientation="vertical", ensure the parent container has an explicit height (e.g., className="flex h-5 items-center") so the line stretches properly.
Login Form Dividers: Pass label="OR" directly to render a centered text divider without writing manual flex wrappers.
Dense Lists & Menus: Inside compact lists or cards, combine variant="muted" and thickness="thin" for a cleaner visual hierarchy.

scroll-area.title: Scroll Area
scroll-area.description: Vertical, horizontal, and bidirectional scroll container featuring a customizable Neobrutalist track and draggable thumb.

props.orientation: Scrollable axis: vertical (default), horizontal, or both.
props.scrollbarSize: Scrollbar thickness: 'sm' (8px default), 'md' (10px), 'lg' (14px), or a custom pixel number (e.g., 6).
props.variant: Outer container style: 'default' (2px border + bg-card) or 'ghost' (borderless & shadowless for embedding inside Cards/Sidebars).
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the outer ScrollArea container.
props.viewportClassName: Additional CSS classes applied directly to the inner scrollable viewport.

usageNotes: Vertical Scrolling: Always provide an explicit height or max-height on ScrollArea (e.g., className="h-60" or className="max-h-80") so overflow triggers properly.
Horizontal Scrolling: Set orientation="horizontal" and wrap inner items in a container with className="flex w-max" so items expand horizontally.
Embedding Inside Cards: Pass variant="ghost" when placing ScrollArea inside a Card or Sidebar to avoid double borders.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Tactile Neobrutalist page navigation supporting ellipsis indicators, compact sizes, First/Last controls, and flat noShadow mode.

props.isActive: Highlights the active page button with the primary variant and sets aria-current="page".
props.size: Controls button dimensions on pagination links: sm, default, or icon.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on pagination buttons, ideal when embedded inside a Card or table footer.
props.disabled: Disables click interactions on PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, PaginationFirst, or PaginationLast at boundary pages.
props.iconOnly: Available on PaginationPrevious & PaginationNext to hide the text label and render an arrow icon button.
props.asChild: Forwards all PaginationLink styles and props to a single child element (such as Next.js <Link />) via Radix Slot.

usageNotes: Next.js App Router Navigation: Use asChild on <PaginationLink asChild><Link href="?page=2">2</Link></PaginationLink> for URL-driven pagination.
Compact Table Footers: Combine <PaginationFirst />, <PaginationPrevious iconOnly />, <PaginationNext iconOnly />, and <PaginationLast /> for dense Data Table footers.
Boundary States: Always pass disabled to Previous/First on page 1 and Next/Last on the final page.

table.title: Table
table.description: Responsive Neobrutalist HTML table primitives featuring accent header blocks, vertical grid lines, striped rows, and compact density.

props.headerVariant: Sets the background color of TableHeader: secondary (default accent block), primary, muted, or default (bg-card).
props.grid: Adds 2px vertical borders between columns in addition to horizontal row dividers.
props.striped: Applies alternating row shading (--muted) on even rows for easier scanning.
props.hoverable: Highlights table rows with an accent color when hovered by the cursor.
props.compact: Reduces cell padding (px-3 py-2) for high-density data views.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the outer table container.
props.containerClassName: Additional CSS classes for the outer table wrapper (e.g., containerClassName="rounded-none border-0" inside a Card).

usageNotes: Embedding Inside a Card: Pass noShadow and containerClassName="rounded-none border-0" on <Table /> along with className="p-0" on <CardContent /> to prevent double borders.
Numeric & Currency Columns: Use font-mono and text-right on amounts, counts, and IDs so values align cleanly.
Need client-side search, sorting, or pagination? Use the Data Table component built on top of Table.

data-table.title: Data Table
data-table.description: Interactive data table powered by @tanstack/react-table with search filtering, column sorting, integrated Pagination controls, row selection, and column visibility toggles.

props.columns: Column definitions typed as ColumnDef<TData, TValue>[] from @tanstack/react-table.
props.data: Array of records to render as table rows.
props.searchKey: Column ID / accessorKey targeted by the toolbar search input.
props.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder text displayed inside the search input.
props.paginated: Enables @tanstack/react-table pagination with Punch UI Pagination controls and rows-per-page selector.
props.pageSize: Initial number of rows per page when paginated is enabled (default: 5).
props.pageSizeOptions: Selectable options for the rows-per-page dropdown (default: [5, 10, 20]).
props.enableColumnVisibility: Displays a Columns toggle menu to show or hide columns dynamically.
props.enableRowSelection: Enables row selection state and displays the selected row count summary.
props.headerVariant: Sets the TableHeader background color (secondary, primary, muted, or default).
props.striped: Applies alternating row shading (--muted) on even rows.
props.hoverable: Highlights rows when hovered by the cursor.
props.compact: Reduces cell padding for dense data views.
props.noShadow: Removes hard shadows from the table, search input, and pagination buttons.

usageNotes: Use DataTableColumnHeader inside your column header renderer (header: ({ column }) => <DataTableColumnHeader column={column} title="Amount" />) to enable click-to-sort with direction icons.
When searchKey is paired with paginated, typing in the search bar automatically resets the table to page 1 so filtered results are never hidden on an empty page.
For static tables without sorting, filtering, or pagination, prefer the lighter Table primitives.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Composable Neobrutalist sidebar navigation featuring solid shadowed active items, collapsible icon rail mode, nested submenus, floating variant, and a responsive mobile drawer.

props.defaultOpen: Sets the initial open/collapsed state on SidebarProvider (default: true).
props.side: Controls which edge the sidebar attaches to: left (default) or right.
props.variant: Layout style of the sidebar: sidebar (default), floating (detached card with shadow-brutal), or inset.
props.collapsible: Desktop collapse behavior: offcanvas (slides away), icon (shrinks to an icon rail), or none.
props.isActive: Highlights the active SidebarMenuButton or SidebarMenuSubButton with a solid accent block.
props.tooltip: Accessible title label displayed on hover when the sidebar is collapsed to icon mode.

usageNotes: Keyboard Shortcut: SidebarProvider automatically binds Ctrl+B (Windows/Linux) and Cmd+B (macOS) to toggle the sidebar.
Place SidebarTrigger inside your top bar so users can open the slide-over drawer on mobile or collapse the sidebar on desktop.
When wrapping Next.js <Link />, pass asChild on <SidebarMenuButton asChild><Link href="...">...</Link></SidebarMenuButton>.

select.title: Select
select.description: Neobrutalist select dropdown powered by @radix-ui/react-select featuring a floating shadowed option menu, grouped items, validation states, and 3 trigger sizes.

props.selectSize: Controls the height and font size of SelectTrigger: sm, default, or lg.
props.state: Applies validation border and shadow styling: default, error, or success.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on SelectTrigger, ideal when embedded inside a Card.
props.clearable: Displays an × button on SelectTrigger (paired with onClear) to clear the active selection.
props.onClear: Callback on SelectTrigger invoked when the clear button is clicked to reset value back to "".
props.position: Positioning strategy for SelectContent: popper (floating below/above trigger, default) or item-aligned (aligns the selected item directly over the trigger).
props.align: Horizontal alignment of SelectContent relative to the trigger when position="popper" (start, center, or end).
props.defaultValue: Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage.
props.value: Controlled selected value paired with onValueChange.
props.disabled: Disables the entire Select control or individual SelectItem entries.

usageNotes: Pair <Label htmlFor="..."> with <SelectTrigger id="..."> for proper accessibility labeling.
Organize long lists with <SelectGroup>, <SelectLabel>, and <SelectSeparator />—the option viewport scrolls cleanly with a standard scrollbar.
Pass noShadow on SelectTrigger inside a Card form to avoid stacked hard shadows.
Need searchable text filtering, rich icons, or multi-select tags? Use the Combobox component instead.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Neobrutalist checkbox powered by @radix-ui/react-checkbox featuring solid accent fills, indeterminate state support, 3 sizes, and error validation.

props.variant: Fill color when checked: primary (default), secondary, success, info, warning, or danger / destructive.
props.checkboxSize: Checkbox dimensions: sm (16px), default (20px), or lg (24px).
props.state: Validation border and shadow state: default or error.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the checkbox box.
props.checked: Controlled checked state: true, false, or "indeterminate".
props.defaultChecked: Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage.

usageNotes: Always pair <Checkbox id="..." /> with <Label htmlFor="..." /> so clicking the label toggles the checkbox.
Pass checked="indeterminate" on a parent Select All checkbox when only a subset of child items are selected.
Use noShadow when embedding Checkbox inside a Card or Data Table row to avoid stacked shadows.

radio-group.title: Radio Group
radio-group.description: Neobrutalist single-choice radio group powered by @radix-ui/react-radio-group with a solid inner indicator, circle or square shapes, 3 sizes, and semantic color variants.

props.orientation: Layout direction on RadioGroup: vertical (default) or horizontal.
props.shape: Geometry of RadioGroupItem: circle (default) or square.
props.radioSize: Dimensions of the radio button: sm, default, or lg.
props.variant: Inner indicator color when selected: primary (default), secondary, success, info, warning, or danger / destructive.
props.state: Validation border and shadow state: default or error.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on RadioGroupItem.
props.defaultValue: Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage.
props.value: Controlled selected value paired with onValueChange.
props.disabled: Disables the entire RadioGroup or an individual RadioGroupItem.

usageNotes: Use RadioGroup for mutually exclusive choices and Checkbox when multiple options can be selected.
Always pair <RadioGroupItem id="..." /> with <Label htmlFor="..." /> for accessible click targets.
When building selectable plan cards, pass noShadow on RadioGroupItem and style the outer card wrapper for active feedback.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: Mechanical Neobrutalist toggle switch powered by @radix-ui/react-switch featuring a 2px-bordered track, pill or square shapes, 3 sizes, and semantic color variants.

props.variant: Track fill color when checked: primary (default), secondary, success, info, warning, or danger / destructive.
props.switchSize: Switch dimensions: sm, default, or lg.
props.shape: Track and thumb geometry: square (default) or pill.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the Switch track.
props.checked: Controlled checked state paired with onCheckedChange.
props.defaultChecked: Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage.

usageNotes: Use Switch for instant on/off toggles (like Airplane Mode or Auto-Deploy), and Checkbox for multi-select forms submitted later.
Pair <Switch id="..." /> with <Label htmlFor="..." /> so clicking the label toggles the switch.
Pass noShadow when placing Switch inside a settings Card to avoid stacked hard shadows.

slider.title: Slider
slider.description: Neobrutalist range slider powered by @radix-ui/react-slider featuring a thick 2px-bordered track, retro square or circle thumbs, multi-thumb range support, and vertical orientation.

props.variant: Active range fill color: primary (default), secondary, success, info, warning, or danger / destructive.
props.sliderSize: Track thickness and thumb dimensions: sm, default, or lg.
props.shape: Track and thumb geometry: square (default) or circle.
props.noShadow: Removes the hard shadow on the track and thumb.
props.defaultValue: Initial value array for uncontrolled usage (e.g., [50] or [25, 75] for a range).
props.value: Controlled value array paired with onValueChange.

usageNotes: To render a dual-thumb Range Slider, pass a 2-element array to value or defaultValue (e.g., defaultValue={[25, 75]}).
When using orientation="vertical", give the parent wrapper an explicit height (such as h-36) so the vertical track renders cleanly.
Display the live numeric value in font-mono and provide an aria-label for clear accessibility.

form.title: Form
form.description: Neobrutalist form primitives integrating react-hook-form and zod schema validation with automatic ARIA wiring and high-contrast error messages.

props.control: The control object returned by useForm() passed to FormField.
props.name: Field name matching a key in your zod schema and defaultValues.
props.render: Render callback receiving { field, fieldState, formState } to bind any input control.
props.useFormField: Hook returning validation error and generated ARIA IDs inside a FormItem.

usageNotes: Pass state={fieldState.error ? "error" : "default"} to Punch UI inputs inside FormControl so red borders and shadows activate on validation failure.
When integrating Select inside a Form, wrap <SelectTrigger /> (not <Select />) with <FormControl>.
Define schemas with z.object(...) and connect them via zodResolver(schema) in useForm().

date-picker.title: Date Picker & Calendar
date-picker.description: Neobrutalist date picker and calendar grid powered by react-day-picker, date-fns, and Popover with range selection, month/year dropdowns, quick presets, and clearable support.

props.value: Selected Date or DateRange for controlled usage.
props.onSelect: Callback invoked when a date or range is selected or cleared.
props.triggerSize: Controls DatePicker trigger dimensions: sm, default, or lg.
props.state: Applies validation border and shadow styling: default, error, or success.
props.clearable: Displays an × button to the left of the calendar icon to clear the selected date.
props.captionLayout: Calendar header mode: label (default) or dropdown (quick month/year selectors).
props.presets: Array of quick-select buttons [{ label, date }] rendered above the calendar.
props.disabledDays: react-day-picker Matcher to disable specific dates (e.g., { before: new Date() }).
props.noShadow: Removes hard shadows from the trigger and calendar popover.

usageNotes: Render <Calendar /> directly when you need an inline always-visible calendar without a Popover.
Enable captionLayout="dropdown" for date-of-birth inputs so users can jump across years quickly.
Inside Form (react-hook-form + zod), bind value={field.value}, onSelect={field.onChange}, and state={fieldState.error ? "error" : "default"}.

command.title: Command
command.description: Fast, keyboard-first Neobrutalist command palette and menu powered by cmdk and Radix Dialog with classic window chrome, categorized groups, and Ctrl+K / ⌘K modal support.

props.noShadow: Removes hard offset shadows on the Command container (useful for flat panels or nested overlays).
props.onOpenChange: Callback fired when CommandDialog opens or closes (via ESC or backdrop click).
props.title: Header bar title rendered in the classic CommandDialog window chrome.
props.heading: Category heading displayed above a CommandGroup.
props.onSelect: Callback invoked when a CommandItem is selected via pointer click or Enter key.
props.disabled: Disables a CommandItem so it cannot be focused or selected.

usageNotes: Attach a global Ctrl+K / ⌘K keydown listener at the layout or page level to open CommandDialog from anywhere.
Place <CommandShortcut> inside <CommandItem> to display consistent keyboard shortcut badges.
Use the keywords prop on CommandItem to match search terms beyond the visible label text.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: Searchable autocomplete selector built by composing Popover and Command, supporting single-select, multi-select with removable Badges, grouped categories, icons, and validation states.

props.options: Array of ComboboxOption items supporting label, description, group, icon, badge, keywords, and disabled.
props.value: Selected value (string for Combobox, string[] for MultiCombobox) in controlled mode.
props.onValueChange: Callback fired whenever the selection changes or is cleared.
props.maxDisplay: Maximum number of Badge pills shown in MultiCombobox before collapsing into a +N badge.
props.clearable: Shows an × button next to the chevron to quickly clear the current selection.
props.triggerSize: Controls trigger dimensions: sm, default, or lg.
props.state: Validation border and shadow state: default, error, or success.
props.noShadow: Removes hard shadows from the trigger button and options popover.

usageNotes: Choose <Combobox /> over <Select /> when the option list is long or benefits from instant text filtering.
Use <MultiCombobox /> for tag or filter selectors where users pick multiple values with removable Badges.
Add keywords to options so users can match aliases, abbreviations, or internal codes while searching.

input-otp.title: Input OTP
input-otp.description: Neobrutalist one-time passcode and PIN input powered by input-otp featuring separate bordered digit boxes with hard shadows per slot, SMS autofill, character patterns, masked mode, and validation states.

props.maxLength: Total number of digits or characters accepted by InputOTP.
props.value: Controlled string value of the OTP code.
props.onChange: Callback fired whenever digits are typed, deleted, or pasted.
props.pattern: Regex pattern restricting allowed characters (e.g. REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS or REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS_AND_CHARS).
props.otpSize: Dimensions of each digit slot box: sm, default, or lg.
props.state: Validation border and shadow state: default, error, or success.
props.masked: Replaces entered characters with solid dots for private PIN entry.
props.noShadow: Removes hard offset shadows on every digit slot.

usageNotes: Pass pattern={REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS} for numeric OTP codes to restrict input and trigger numeric keypads on mobile.
Full multi-digit paste and native SMS autofill (autocomplete="one-time-code") work out of the box.
Enable masked for sensitive 4-to-6 digit PIN fields.
